info.title: Audiaptic WebSocket API
info.description: Real-time connections to the server. All sockets live under `/api`, behind the Caddy proxy.

tags.name: performer
tags.description: The performer driving the show. Will require authentication.

api.description: The API app, behind the Caddy proxy.

performer.title: Performer
performer.description: The performer sends one event or a list of events per frame; every frame is answered with exactly one ack, in the order the frames arrived. The server sets no event or size limit of its own; a frame over the WebSocket library's 100 MiB default closes the socket with close code 1009 instead of being acked.

audience.title: Audience
audience.description: Audience devices receive the valid show events from each performer frame in the form the performer sent them: a single event, or a list. Devices send nothing back yet. If the join code is invalid, the server closes the socket with close code 4404 and reason "Invalid join code".

code.description: The performance join code. Only `davhi` is valid for now.

performerSendsEvent.title: Send events
performerSendsEvent.summary: Performer → server: one event, or a list of events.

performerReceivesAck.title: Receive an ack
performerReceivesAck.summary: Server → performer: exactly one ack per frame.

audienceReceivesEvent.title: Receive events
audienceReceivesEvent.summary: Server → audience: a show event, or a list of them, relayed from the performer.

eventList.name: event list
eventList.title: Event list
eventList.summary: Performer → server: a non-empty list of events in one frame.
eventList.description: Each event is validated on its own, so valid events are relayed even when others are rejected. An eventId already used earlier in the same frame is rejected.

ack.name: ack
ack.title: Ack
ack.summary: Server → performer: exactly one ack per frame, whether it held one event or a list.
ack.description:
The status is the first of these that applies:

- `400`: The frame is not valid JSON.
- `422`: The frame is not an event or a non-empty list of events, or no event in it is valid. Nothing was relayed.
- `500`: The events were valid, but the server failed to send them to the audience.
- `207`: Partial success: the valid show events were relayed, and the invalid ones are listed in `rejected`.
- `202`: Every event was valid, and the show events were relayed.
- `200`: Every event was valid, and there was nothing to relay (for example, only pings).

audienceEventList.name: audience event list
audienceEventList.title: Audience event list
audienceEventList.summary: Server → audience: the valid show events from a performer list, in frame order.
audienceEventList.description: Sent when the performer sent a list, even if only one of its events was valid.
